description: Extract TikTok subtitles and transcripts as timestamped segments and plain text. One row per language per video.

includeAllTranslations.description: Best-effort: request TikTok's machine translation for every supported target language. Coverage varies by video and this adds up to 20 extra requests per video.
includeAllTranslations.title: Include All Translations

includeSrt.description: Include generated SRT subtitles in each transcript row.
includeSrt.title: Include SRT

includeVtt.description: Include the original or generated WebVTT text in each transcript row.
includeVtt.title: Include WebVTT

languages.description: Optional language filter. Accepts TikTok codes (eng-US, spa-ES) and ISO/English aliases (en, English, es, Spanish). Listed languages missing from the video are requested as best-effort TikTok translations. Leave empty for every track on the default page.
languages.title: Languages

postIds.description: Numeric TikTok video IDs as strings, as an alternative to postUrls.
postIds.title: Video IDs

postUrls.description: TikTok video URLs to process. Full video URLs, @user/photo URLs, short share links, and bare numeric IDs are accepted. Duplicate IDs are processed once.
postUrls.title: Video URLs

useWhisperFallback.description: Transcribe videos with no native captions using local Whisper. Slower and opt-in; detected language is best-effort, especially on short clips.
useWhisperFallback.title: Use Whisper Fallback

title: TikTok Transcript Scraper Input
